name: George Washington
fact: The only president elected unanimously by the Electoral College, and he did it twice.

name: John Adams
fact: The first president to live in the White House, moving in before it was finished.

name: Thomas Jefferson
fact: Died on July 4, 1826, the Declaration's 50th anniversary, hours before John Adams.

name: James Madison
fact: The "Father of the Constitution" and the shortest president, at 5 ft 4 in.

name: James Monroe
fact: Liberia's capital, Monrovia, is named after him.

name: John Quincy Adams
fact: Served 17 years in the House after his presidency, fighting slavery the whole time.

name: Andrew Jackson
vp: John C. Calhoun, Martin Van Buren
fact: Survived the first assassination attempt on a president when both of the attacker's pistols misfired.

name: Martin Van Buren
fact: The first president born a US citizen, and his first language was Dutch.

name: William Henry Harrison
fact: Died 31 days into office, the shortest presidency ever.

name: John Tyler
fact: The first VP to take over after a president died. Critics called him "His Accidency."

name: James K. Polk
fact: Promised to serve one term, grew the country by about a third, and kept the promise.

name: Zachary Taylor
fact: A career soldier who had never voted in a presidential election before his own.

name: Millard Fillmore
fact: The last Whig president.

name: Franklin Pierce
fact: Delivered his entire inaugural address from memory.

name: James Buchanan
fact: The only president who never married.

name: Abraham Lincoln
fact: The only president to hold a patent, for a device to lift boats over shoals.

name: Andrew Johnson
fact: The first president to be impeached. The Senate acquitted him by a single vote.

name: Ulysses S. Grant
fact: Born Hiram Ulysses Grant. A West Point paperwork error gave him the "S."

name: Rutherford B. Hayes
fact: Won the disputed 1876 election by a single electoral vote.

name: James A. Garfield
fact: Shot four months into office. He died 11 weeks later, largely from his doctors' infections.

name: Chester A. Arthur
fact: Signed the Pendleton Act, which started hiring federal workers on merit.

name: Grover Cleveland
vp: Thomas A. Hendricks, Adlai E. Stevenson
fact: The only president to get married in the White House.

name: Benjamin Harrison
fact: William Henry Harrison's grandson. His White House was the first with electricity.

name: William McKinley
fact: Assassinated in 1901 at the Pan-American Exposition in Buffalo.

name: Theodore Roosevelt
fact: The youngest president ever, at 42. The teddy bear is named after him.

name: William Howard Taft
fact: Later became Chief Justice, the only person to hold both jobs.

name: Woodrow Wilson
fact: The only president with a PhD.

name: Warren G. Harding
fact: Died in office. His administration is remembered for the Teapot Dome scandal.

name: Calvin Coolidge
fact: The only president born on the Fourth of July.

name: Herbert Hoover
fact: A millionaire mining engineer who gave his presidential salary to charity.

name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
vp: John N. Garner, Henry A. Wallace, Harry S. Truman
fact: The only president elected four times.

name: Harry S. Truman
fact: The "S" doesn't stand for anything. It honored both of his grandfathers.

name: Dwight D. Eisenhower
fact: Led the Allied invasion on D-Day, then as president launched the Interstate Highway System.

name: John F. Kennedy
fact: The youngest person ever elected president, at 43, and the first Catholic president.

name: Lyndon B. Johnson
fact: Sworn in aboard Air Force One hours after Kennedy's assassination.

name: Richard Nixon
fact: The only president to resign.

name: Gerald Ford
fact: The only president never elected as either president or vice president.

name: Jimmy Carter
fact: The longest-lived president, at 100. He won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2002.

name: Ronald Reagan
fact: A Hollywood actor who was once president of the Screen Actors Guild.

name: George H. W. Bush
fact: A WWII Navy pilot who was shot down over the Pacific in 1944.

name: Bill Clinton
fact: Played the saxophone on The Arsenio Hall Show during his 1992 campaign.

name: George W. Bush
fact: The second son of a president to become president, after John Quincy Adams.

name: Barack Obama
fact: The first African American president, and the only one born in Hawaii.

name: Donald Trump
fact: The first president with no prior government or military experience.

name: Joe Biden
fact: Spent 36 years as a senator from Delaware before becoming vice president.
